name: Portobello Veggie Burger Stack with Onions, Chimichurri & Potatoes

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg new potatoes
6 caps portobello mushrooms
2 small bunches cilantro
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Quarter potatoes and divide between two baking sheet pans. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until potatoes are fork-tender, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and slice onions crosswise into ¼-inch thick rings. Place on a platter.
Remove stems from the mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills; add to the platter with the onions. Drizzle veggies with oil, and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, place mushrooms and onions on the pan. Grill until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes per side. Return to the platter.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro and parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half of the herbs in a medium bowl and set aside; place the other half in a large bowl.
Add veggie ground, salt, and pepper to the large bowl with the herbs; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g veggie ground, plant based
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, coat the pan with oil. Working in batches if necessary, place burger patties on the grill pan and cook, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove to the platter with the veggies.
While the burgers are cooking, peel and mince garlic; add to the medium bowl with the herbs, along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Stir to combine the chimichurri and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide potatoes and grilled mushrooms between plates. Layer each mushroom with a burger patty, tomato, and onions; spoon chimichurri over top and enjoy!
